NovaTech Solutions Pvt. Ltd.
Leave Policy
 Document ID
NT-HR-001
Department
Human Resources
Version
3.2
Effective Date
01 April 2025
1. Purpose and Scope
This policy explains the types of leave available to all full-time employees of NovaTech Solutions. It
applies to employees in all offices after they have completed onboarding. Interns and contractors
are covered by their individual agreements.
2. Annual (Earned) Leave
Every full-time employee receives 24 days of paid annual leave per calendar year. Leave is
credited at 2 days per month. Employees may carry forward a maximum of 10 unused annual
leave days to the next year; any balance above 10 days lapses on 31 December. Annual leave of
more than 5 consecutive working days must be applied for at least 14 days in advance and
approved by the reporting manager.
3. Sick Leave
Employees are entitled to 12 days of paid sick leave per year. Sick leave cannot be carried forward
or encashed. A medical certificate from a registered doctor is required if sick leave exceeds 2
consecutive days. Employees must inform their manager before 10:00 AM on the first day of
sickness.
4. Casual Leave
Each employee gets 8 days of casual leave per year for personal matters. A maximum of 3 casual
leave days can be taken together at one time. Casual leave cannot be combined with sick leave.
5. Maternity, Paternity and Parental Leave
Female employees are entitled to 26 weeks of paid maternity leave for the first two children. Male
employees are entitled to 10 working days of paid paternity leave, which must be taken within 3
months of the child's birth. Adoption leave of 12 weeks is available to the primary caregiver.
6. Bereavement and Marriage Leave
Employees get 5 days of paid bereavement leave on the death of an immediate family member
(parent, spouse, child or sibling). Employees receive 5 days of paid marriage leave for their own
marriage, applied at least 30 days in advance.
7. Public Holidays
NovaTech observes 12 public holidays each year. The list is published on the HR portal in the first
week of January. Employees may also choose 2 optional (floating) holidays from a published list.
8. Leave Without Pay

Leave without pay (LWP) may be approved by the department head for up to 30 days in a year
when all paid leave has been used. LWP beyond 30 days requires approval from the HR Director.
Document Notice
